posts.title: Re-gilding of the massive Arts of War sculptures, located between The Lincoln Memorial and site of The Triumphal Arch, rapidly continues. The sculptures will be fully regilded by July 3rd. The photos below were taken yesterday. The Gilders’ Studio has flown in Gilders from around the Country to perform this work!
posts.text:
Re-gilding of the massive Arts of War sculptures, located between The Lincoln Memorial and site of The Triumphal Arch, rapidly continues. The sculptures will be fully regilded by July 3rd. The photos below were taken yesterday. The Gilders’ Studio has flown in Gilders from around the Country to perform this work!

[Image] Three views show artists working on a large yellow sculpture of a rearing horse inside scaffolding. The horse’s head, mane, and facial features are coated in reflective gold, while other sections remain bright yellow. Workers use brushes and tools to apply or touch up the finish from wooden platforms, surrounded by supplies and protective materials.

posts.text: [Image] Three views show the National Mall’s reflecting pool aligned with the Washington Monument in Washington, D.C. In the daytime images, grounds workers stand at the pool’s edge, using long poles and maintenance equipment, while trees, paths, service carts, and a few ducks surround the water. The nighttime view shows the illuminated monument and its reflection beneath a dark blue sky.
